gloss: to run away; to run off

definitions.gloss: to run away; to run off; to dash away
definitions.explanation: To leave a place quickly by running. A compound of 走る (to run) and 去る (to leave), emphasizing both the speed and the departure.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}が{走|はし}り{去|さ}った。
{子供|こども}たちは{笑|わら}いながら{走|はし}り{去|さ}っていった。
{不審者|ふしんしゃ}は{声|こえ}をかけられると、{走|はし}り{去|さ}って{姿|すがた}を{消|け}した。
examples.english: When called out to, the suspicious person ran off and disappeared.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: {走|はし}る (to run) + {去|さ}る (to go away). The ～{去|さ}る pattern indicates moving away from the speaker's perspective, seen also in {飛|と}び{去|さ}る (to fly away) and {逃|に}げ{去|さ}る (to flee).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走|はし}り{去|さ}っていく (to run off in a direction away from the speaker)
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で{走|はし}り{去|さ}る (to dash away in an instant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {駆|か}け{去|さ}る: to dash away — more literary or dramatic
- {逃|に}げ{去|さ}る: to flee — implies escaping from something
- {走|はし}り{出|だ}す: to start running — focuses on beginning rather than departing
